name: project-merge-rebuild
body: The merge-and-rebuild act: `rust.apg.project_cmd.merge.project_merge_at` runs the verify gate, merges the project branch into the default branch (fast-forward or merge commit), then runs a plain unguarded scan of main (`rust.apg.project_cmd.merge.project_merge`). That rebuild is where a spec-only merge must land the authored rows in main's `db.lbug`.
